name: society-management
description: Documentation toolchain for the Society Management codebase (28 module identities).

scripts.docs:api: for f in src/*/*.js tests/*/*.js; do jsdoc2md --configure jsdoc.json --files "$f" > "docs/api-reference/$(basename "$f" .js).md"; done
scripts.docs:diagrams: for f in docs/assets/diagrams/*.mmd; do mmdc -i "$f" -o "${f%.mmd}.svg"; done
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:diagrams && npm run docs:pdf
